prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name a single “best” interior painter for all situations — the right company depends on your home, budget, timeline and quality expectations. I don’t have live web access to pull current ratings, but I can help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed:

1) Quick questions so I can tailor recommendations
- Is this a residential or commercial project?
- How many rooms / total square footage?
- What’s your timeline?
- Do you want premium finishes (e.g., skim-coat, drywall repair, specialty paints) or a standard paint refresh?
- Share your ZIP code if you want me to suggest local companies to investigate.

2) How to identify the best interior painter in St. Louis
- Get at least 3 written estimates that break out prep, paint, labor and cleanup.
- Check recent photos/portfolio of finished interiors (not just marketing images).
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and ask for references from the contractor (call recent customers).
- Verify insurance (general liability and workers’ comp) and ask about licensing or local registration requirements.
- Ask what brand and sheen of paint they use, and if high-quality products are included (e.g., Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams).
- Confirm scope: number of coats, surface prep (sanding, patching, priming), protection of floors/furniture, trim work, caulking, door/trim finish, and touch-up procedures.
- Make sure there’s a clear start date, estimated completion date, and a written warranty/guarantee for workmanship.
- Verify they provide a written contract with payment schedule (avoid large up-front cash payments).

3) Red flags
- No business address or poor online presence
- Vague or verbal-only estimates
- Requests for full payment up front
- Extremely low bids with no line-item detail

4) Typical price guidance (ballpark)
- Small room refresh often ranges a few hundred dollars to $1,000 depending on prep and quality.
- Whole-home interior painting commonly ranges from a few thousand to $10,000+, depending on size/finish level.
(If you want a more specific estimate, tell me room sizes or square footage.)

If you want, give your ZIP code and a bit more about the job and I’ll suggest several local painters to research and a template message you can send to get comparable bids.
